issue: GEM Phase 1 Capacity = 0.07 mtpa (~200 t/day). This matches one documented plan (Phase 1 = 200 t/day LNG by end-2026), but the sponsor's CURRENT framing conflicts: Botala's own project page describes phases by PJ/year tiers (Phase 1 ~0.25 PJ/yr, scaling to 3.5 PJ/yr ~200 t/day at full build), and Offshore Energy (offshore-energy.biz) reports Phase 1 = 50 t/day by 2026, Phase 2 = >200 t/day by 2028. The 200/800 t/day phasing and the 50/>200 t/day phasing are both in circulation. No single current capacity value is cleanly corroborated by >=2 independent sources, so the numeric Capacity was NOT re-confirmed (left uncolored).
suggested_action: Obtain Botala's bankable feasibility study (BFS) outcome or the latest ASX/BSE plant-design release to pin the definitive Phase 1 / Phase 2 nameplate. Until then treat 0.07/0.29 mtpa as provisional. CapacityUnits (mtpa) is correct.
